answer_1.quote: Experimental results show that LLaMA-Omni 2 achieves outstanding performance on spoken question answering and speech instruction following tasks in both speech-to-text and speech-to-speech settings.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the model using the following metrics: ChatGPT Score ... ASR-WER ... UTMOS ... Latency ...

answer_3.quote: ChatGPT Score: To evaluate the model's ability to follow instructions, we use [ChatGPT] to score the model's responses. It considers factors such as helpfulness, relevance, fluency, and suitability for speech interaction scenarios, and assigns a single score between 1 and 5.
